down_idle.action: subtle breathing, lantern sways slightly, one blink

side_idle.action: subtle breathing, lantern sways slightly, one blink

up_idle.action: subtle breathing seen from behind, lantern sways slightly

down_walk.action: walking toward the viewer, alternating legs, lantern swinging

side_walk.action: walking to the right in profile, alternating legs, lantern swinging

up_walk.action: walking away from the viewer, alternating legs, lantern swinging

down_gather.action: bends down to pick something up from the ground with the free hand, then stands back up

down_attack.action: swings the lantern overhead and strikes down in front, windup, strike, follow-through, recover; no detached effects

style: hand-drawn gothic storybook ink illustration, Don't Starve style, thick wobbly black outlines, muted sepia/teal/rust palette, cream sticker outline
